title: $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills thermodynamics from effective field theory
summary: We compute the weak-coupling free energy density of pure four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills (SYM) theory through second order in the 't Hooft coupling $λ$ at finite temperature using effective-field-theory methods. The contribution from the hard scale $T$ is obtained from massless three-loop vacuum diagrams in the full theory, and that from the electric scale $\sqrtλ\,T$ from a two-loop calculation in the dimensionally reduced three-dimensional effective theory.
